'''Liliane Léger''' née Quercy ({{IPA|fr|liljan leʒe}}; born August 22, 1944) is a French [[Physicien|physicist]]. Her research considers polymers and the molecular mechanisms of adhesion. She was awarded the Groupe Français d’Études et d’Applications des Polymères Prix d’Honneur in 2021.

== Early life and education ==
Léger was born in [[Charenton-le-Pont]]. She was a student at [[Lycée Pasteur (Neuilly-sur-Seine)|Lycée Pasteur]]. After completing high school, Leger joined the [[Nouvelle université de Paris|University of Paris]], where she worked toward a bachelor's degree in Atomic and Molecular Physics.{{cn|date=February 2022}} She moved to the [[Laboratoire de Physique des Solides]] in 1967, where she was trained in solid state physics. She remained in Orsay for her doctoral research, working in the laboratory of Georges Durand and [[:fr:Madeleine Veyssié|Madeleine Veyssié]]. Her doctoral research considered the thermal fluctuations of nematic liquid crystals. She defended her thesis on the elastic and dynamic properties of  mesomorphic phases under the supervision of [[:fr:Pierre-Gilles de Gennes|P.-G. de Gennes]] in 1975.<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Étude expérimentale des propriétés élastiques et dynamiques de certaines phases mésomorphes|date=1976|place=S.l|language=fr|first=Liliane|last=Leger-Quercy|oclc=489718375 }}</ref>

== Research and career ==
Léger joined the polymer group at the [[Collège de France]] in 1977 and was appointed head of group just over ten years later. In 1985, she became head of the Polymers team at the Collège de France. She was appointed professor at the [[Université Paris-Sud|University of Paris-Sud]] in 1988. She returned to the [[Laboratoire de Physique des Solides]] Adhesion, Friction and Polymer group. She was made an emeritus professor in 2009.{{cn|date=February 2022}}

In 2016 the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] held a conference in Léger's honour.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-10-17|title=Conference in honour of Liliane Léger|url=https://gdr3535.sciencesconf.org/data/pages/program.pdf|access-date=2022-02-17}}</ref>

* 2004 [[Société Française de Physique|French Physical Society]] Prix Félix Robin<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prix Félix Robin - Société Française de Physique|url=https://sfpnet.fr/prix/prix-felix-robin|access-date=2022-02-17|website=sfpnet.fr|language=fr}}</ref>
* 2005 Elected to the [[Legion of Honour]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Décret du 31 décembre 2005 portant promotion et nomination|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000000456787|access-date=2022-02-17|website=www.legifrance.gouv.fr}}</ref>
* 2015 Elected Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=APS Fellow Archive|url=http://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm|access-date=2022-02-17|website=www.aps.org|language=en}}</ref>
* 2021 Groupe Français d’Études et d’Applications des Polymères Prix d’Honneur<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prix d'Honneur {{!}} Groupe Français d'Etudes et d'Applications des Polymères|url=https://www.gfp.asso.fr/prix-dhonneur|access-date=2022-02-17|language=fr-FR}}</ref>
